configure terminal

Enter configuration commands, one per line. End with CNTL/Z.

host01(config)# no interface loopback 900


host01(config)# no interface vlan 3900


host01(config)# no vlan 3900


host01(config)# no vrf context nxos-routing-admin


host01(config)# no ip route 198.51.100.0/24 192.0.2.250


host01(config)# no ipv6 route 2001:db8::/32 2001:db8:ffff::fe


host01(config)# end


host01#
